hierarchy.h3: font-['Unbounded'] text-xl sm:text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-white

layout_spacing.grid_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 md:gap-8
layout_spacing.glass_card: relative overflow-hidden rounded-2xl bg-[#140A1E]/40 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 p-8 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(176,38,255,0.05)]
layout_spacing.alignment: Mobile-first responsive. Left-align for dense data, center-align for hero and major section titles.

animations_and_interactions.loader: Implement a custom full-screen loader with background #030008. Use Framer Motion to draw the 'SYSTEM O-JDEV' logo using an SVG path animation in #B026FF, followed by a neon glow reveal, before fading out via AnimatePresence.
animations_and_interactions.buttons: Create a custom RippleButton component. On click, a circular ripple spans out. On hover, increase inner glow and slightly lift (-translate-y-1). Active state should use scale-95.
animations_and_interactions.portfolio_cards: Premium Hover State: Apply overflow-hidden to image container. On group-hover, scale the image to scale-110 with a smooth 0.5s transition. Overlay a glassmorphic gradient bg-gradient-to-tr from-[#B026FF]/50 to-transparent that fades in, and slide up a 'View Project' badge/button.
animations_and_interactions.scroll: Utilize Lenis for smooth scrolling momentum. Add Framer Motion staggered reveals (opacity: 0, y: 30 to opacity: 1, y: 0) for bento grid children.
animations_and_interactions.cursor: Maintain neon glow cursor. Add a scale effect when hovering over interactive elements (buttons, links).

components.hero: Center-aligned H1. Integrate existing 3D coin. Overlay subtle noise texture (bg-noise) on the hero background to enhance luxury feel.
components.stats: Counter components using framer-motion useInView. Typography: Unbounded, text-4xl or 5xl, text-[#E35BFF].
components.tech_marquee: Kinetic Texture approach. Extremely slow, smooth drift using react-fast-marquee. Low-contrast monochrome items (e.g., text-white/20) in JetBrains Mono.
components.service_cards: Bento grid layout. Glassmorphism surfaces. Animated borders on hover.
components.portfolio: Grid layout. Thum.io screenshots. Sharp borders (border-white/10), rounded-xl.
components.differentials_process: Vertical timeline or 4-step horizontal bento layout with glowing connector lines.
components.contact_form: Shadcn UI customized. Deep dark inputs (bg-white/5), focus rings using #B026FF. Integration with FastAPI.
components.cta: Massive premium banner. Gradient text for the headline bg-clip-text text-transparent bg-gradient-to-r from-[#B026FF] to-[#E35BFF].

media.notes: Project thumbnails generated via thum.io. Neon 3D coin provided by client.

instructions_to_main_agent: Replace Inter and Space Grotesk with Unbounded, Outfit, and JetBrains Mono.
Add the provided fonts to tailwind.config.js.
Implement the custom loader using Framer Motion before mounting the main application.
Build the Button component with the specified click ripple and glow hover states.
Refine the portfolio cards to feature the high-end hover scaling and glassmorphic sheen overlay.
Ensure the neon cursor glow remains above the DOM but doesn't block clicks (pointer-events-none).
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes.
